rows.uncertainty: Abstract only: no VAS, IGA or PSS values, no per-group effect sizes, no time point for the between-group comparison, and no number or spacing of sessions for any arm. 122 lesions from 18 patients means several lesions per patient [about 6.8 on average]; whether one patient contributed lesions to more than one group, and whether clustering was handled, is not stated, so the p values may treat correlated lesions as independent. Number of patients per group not given, and the abstract reports only analysed counts (122 lesions, 18 patients), so enrolment and dropouts cannot be checked. Mean age is printed as '70.00 ± 20.00 years', an unusually round and wide figure for 18 patients; check in full text. 'Significantly improved after the second treatment' does not say which group or groups, nor against what. None of the endpoints compares lesion colour with surrounding skin, so colour match cannot be judged. Design words (randomised, blinded, prospective) are not stated for this study; the background sentence says no prospective comparative studies existed before it.
